output.revised_prompt:
Edit Image 1 (the coral-red and jade cabinet) into a complete commercial-grade production portrait slot cabinet master background. Use Image 1 as the strict identity and structural edit target; use Image 2 only as a reference for functional completeness and integrated manufactured hardware, never copy its black-gold decoration, palace styling, vault, ornament, or exact layout.

Preserve Image 1’s unique broad upswept jade canopy, coral-red lacquer body, joyful peach/champagne-gold identity, visible gears/mechanism, frontal symmetry, and friendly fortune-festival mood. Create a true straight-on front elevation showing the entire uncropped cabinet from canopy to base, broad and mechanically distinct from ruby, classic, and coin machines.

Required integrated layout, all physically built into the cabinet:
1. Directly under the broad canopy, add a wide blank metal-and-jade title plaque, with absolutely no text, letters, numbers, logos, or symbols.
2. Beneath it, add a separate narrow horizontal black glass counter window with a ruby-toned frame/indicator details, intended as a GRAND counter socket, but keep the entire face blank with no baked-in text or digits.
3. Main reel area: clean warm-ivory glass, exactly 5 columns by 3 rows, empty cells, thin peach-gold horizontal grid lines, and strong vertical brushed-metal drum dividers. No icons or symbols inside any reel cell.
4. Below reels, add a separate narrow jade-and-black feature/result glass window, blank and unobstructed.
5. Add a wide, deep physical jade control shelf, clearly a real cast component rather than floating UI. All controls must belong to the same casting and sit in believable recessed wells with screws, seams, bevels, joints, and hardware.
6. On shelf from left to right: a brass Turbo rocker socket with a broad blank face; two separate small brass key/button sockets for Paytable and Rules, each with broad blank faces; a paired Bet minus/plus knob well using two blank physical knobs with no minus/plus symbols; a large central emerald-jade Spin dome in a substantial cast peach-gold bezel, blank; a right-side Auto lever/button socket, blank. Arrange cleanly and ergonomically, keep every control fully visible and unobstructed. No words on any control.

Make the cabinet commercially believable and mechanically complete: polished jade inserts, coral-red enamel/lacquer, brushed brass, satin champagne and peach-gold bevels, cream reel glass, black glass counter windows, small ruby indicator lamps, tiny screws, gear teeth, cast seams, access joints, drum structure, manufactured panel gaps, and a stable complete lower cabinet/base. Retain tasteful visible mechanism from Image 1, but avoid excessive ornament.

Lighting: soft warm casino-floor illumination, luminous jade highlights, expensive but approachable, playful fortune-festival energy, not ceremonial, not solemn. Background softly blurred and secondary.

Hard constraints: no baked-in words, letters, numbers, typographic marks, logos, labels, watermarks, people, banknotes, alcohol, floating UI, reel symbols, palace motifs, heavy imperial ornament, dark black-gold club mood, copied vault elements, or cropped cabinet. Blank surfaces must remain broad enough for later code-rendered labels. True front elevation, centered, symmetrical, production-quality UI mockup asset, portrait orientation.
